title: SimpleXMLElement exposes child XML elements as dynamic properties via C object handlers

ground_truth.statement: SimpleXMLElement exposes XML child elements as properties via ext-simplexml C object handlers without declared properties, __get(), or @property tags. Both isset($xml->title) and (string) $xml->title execute cleanly at runtime without error.

notes: Verified against PHP 8.3.36, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.1, and Mago 1.60.2.
